FREE SAMPLES FOR RD PURPOSE | HYDERABAD ACC INHYD4, India | DHAKA, Bangladesh | 30024129 | BOL 1099237". Source counter: page states 1552 total shipments / 64 trading partners / 76 ports; free view displayed 5 dated shipment rows (4 export rows + 1 import row) and 5 supplier/buyer aggregate rows — only the 5 dated rows were read, the remaining ~1547 are behind the paywall.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, volza/eximpedia/trademo returned HTTP 403, importgenius returned a JavaScript challenge, and the company website indianimmunologicals.com did not resolve (DNS error). web_search backend was down (searx connection refused) for the whole session. No domestic supply record was seen, but this is a retrieval gap, not a negative finding.
note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records with destination, HS code and B/L number: Philippines (HS 30024119, B/L 1040695, 2026-02-26), Kenya (HS 30024200, B/L 9940362, 2026-02-23), Bangladesh (HS 30024129, B/L 1099237, 2026-02-27). Declared HS 300490 does not match the observed codes — actual shipments are vaccines under HS 30024119 / 30024129 / 30024200 (and one import of HS 30049099 from Poland). Per rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the observed vaccine codes (3002.41 / 3002.42) with 30049099 noted for the inbound leg; verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' is wrong — the company is a veterinary/human vaccine manufacturer (Biological E group, Hyderabad). Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in the sources reachable. Domestic supply status left as unknown rather than none_found because all domestic-evidence sources were blocked, not because they were checked and empty.
